verdict.rationale: Square appears to publish its API specification through the official square/connect-api-specification GitHub repository. Its README is cited, but the quoted text only steers users toward pre-built clients rather than describing the spec file itself. Probes of the standard OpenAPI paths on developer.squareup.com all returned 404. That shows no spec at the well-known URLs, but it doesn't contradict a GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the spec format (OpenAPI/Swagger) and a direct download path, a spec at a discoverable developer-portal URL, confirmation that the spec is current, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You probably want to just use one of the clients that are pre-built in a language of your choice
The Connect Examples are working sample applications that you can copy from to build your own.
